representation: A four-bucket hash table with h(k) = k mod 4, two stored keys chained in bucket 2, and a movable incoming-key token.
entities: four bucket cells with index labels
stored keys 10 and 22 as a chain in bucket 2
motion: the incoming token moves horizontally to bucket h(k)
the token pulses to show insertion
the arrow points into the target bucket
checkpoints: move the key and see chaining rather than sorting
misconceptionTest: Keys 10 and 22 are distinct yet share bucket 2, so the scene shows that collisions happen and are resolved by chaining. Bucket order is index order; the scene never claims insertion or sorted order. An incoming key with a different residue visibly leaves bucket 2.
accessibility: Bucket indices and key values are text, the incoming token is labeled k and has an arrow, the slider is keyboard accessible, and alt text summarizes the collision and chain.
